# Regression fixtures

These self-contained neutral documents exercise the application's supported interchange contract. Archive envelopes contain minimal synthetic JSON and matching hashes. They contain no executable extensions, application bundles, session credentials, or game asset archives.

Tests mutate copies to exercise rejection, atomicity, privacy, and reference remapping. These fixtures are not a claim of live interoperability with every external application or format revision. Technical format identifiers remain unchanged because they are part of the interchange schema.
